insert into safety_build_device (ID,DEVICE_CODE,DEVICE_NAME,EXTEND_CODE,AREA_ID,AREA_NAME,FACTORY_CODE, FACTORY_NAME,TERM_ID,TERM_ADDR,TERM_NAME,TERM_TYPE,LEVF,DEVICE_STATUS,device_type, CREATE_TIME,REMOVE_FLAG,UPDATE_TIME) values
(#{item.id}, #{item.deviceCode}, #{item.deviceName}, #{item.extendCode}, #{item.areaId}, #{item.areaName}, #{item.factoryCode}, #{item.factoryName}, #{item.termId}, #{item.termAddr}, #{item.termName}, #{item.termType}, #{item.levf}, #{item.deviceStatus}, #{item.deviceType}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{item.removeFlag}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE DEVICE_NAME = VALUES(DEVICE_NAME), EXTEND_CODE = VALUES(EXTEND_CODE), AREA_ID = VALUES(AREA_ID), AREA_NAME = VALUES(AREA_NAME), FACTORY_CODE = VALUES(FACTORY_CODE), FACTORY_NAME = VALUES(FACTORY_NAME), TERM_ID = VALUES(TERM_ID), TERM_ADDR = VALUES(TERM_ADDR), TERM_NAME = VALUES(TERM_NAME), TERM_TYPE = VALUES(TERM_TYPE), LEVF = VALUES(LEVF), DEVICE_STATUS = VALUES(DEVICE_STATUS), REMOVE_FLAG=VALUES(REMOVE_FLAG), UPDATE_TIME = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, IS_DELETE = VALUES(IS_DELETE)
